entries.6d35b3d7dd4b5f5e: Continuing the strategy by which it has grown by making capital investments such as mechanization of manufacturing processes ahead of other companies and providing large volumes of inexpensive products, it will aim to improve production capacity and production efficiency through active capital investment going forward. Its key strategy is to maintain and expand its share in its home region of the Chugoku and Shikoku regions and the Kinki region, and to fully launch sales activities in the Kanto region, the largest market in Japan, using the Mt. Fuji foothills factory to expand its share. In addition, it will work on automating products that are difficult to make but in high demand, and aim to raise sales unit prices by having customers recognize the quality and value of its products.
